Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Pet Selection Stage: Redesign the companion pick screen into a stage layout featuring live animated preview cards and quick selection options. (why: Adoption has the lowest funnel conversion (60.9%) and long decision time (89s median). Giving clearer live visual previews speeds up decision-making.)
1: [home, wait_info] Visual Waiting Progress Ticker: Add an engaging progress tracker and interactive tips carousel to the waiting generation screen. (why: The home waiting step takes a mean of 2336s (median 201s), causing user drop-off if they think the app froze.)
2: [finish, copy] Direct Launch Call-to-Action: Update final screen button copy and headline to emphasize instant desktop activation. (why: Completion on the final screen drops to 64.8% with high mean delay, suggesting users don't realize setup is finished.)
3: [home, notification] Desktop Ready Alert Notification: Enable desktop notification prompts and audio chime when pet asset rendering completes. (why: High waiting time (median 201s) leads users to background the window and abandon setup before seeing their pet.)
4: [choose_path, copy] Streamlined Onboarding Story Copy: Simplify intro story text to clearly explain desktop pet capabilities in 3 brief points. (why: Choose path step shows a high mean time of 514s, indicating slow engagement with initial introduction text.)
